topography.project_purpose: NFT Lending. Structurally: 86 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 28 ERC20 tokens, 4 ERC721 NFTs, 1 ERC1155 multi-token, 3 Chainlink feeds; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 4 functional families. Its contracts share 34 common project-authored base contract(s) (ctoken, ctokeninterface, ctokenstorage). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
